quest.title: The Hook's Unexpected Adventure
quest.description: Kayvan and Helbet are busy trying to do something...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of materials do you need this time?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Let me think... I'll use Padisarah this time.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: An ordinary one will do.

talks.objective: Give the bait materials to Kayvan

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Not bad. Now, it's time to fish. I'm gonna catch a big one this time!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kayvan prepares the bait and begins fishing...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kayvan catches a wet package a short while later...

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: Uh... Let me have a look...

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: Huh? The things in here... They seem like lost items again...

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: Uh... We've been fishing ever since Mr. Kayvan and I went to that researcher to modify our bait...

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: But Mr. Kayvan still fishes up strange things every single time.

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: Including lost items, ore from the bottom of the river, packages that fell off ships...

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: Even some adventurer who accidentally fell into the water once grabbed onto Mr. Kayvan's fishing line to get out of the water...

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: But we just can't catch any fish...

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: My fishing career has come to its end...

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: M—Mr. Kayvan! Cheer up! L—Look, the owner of this thing is definitely anxious.

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: He'll definitely be overjoyed that you fished it up.

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: We may even be compensated when we take these lost items back to the Adventurers' Guild!

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: But... I really! I really just want—

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: I really just want to catch a fish!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What sort of materials do you need this time?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Let me think... This time, I need... Uh... a Special Sweet Flower.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: There's a place with pretty good Sweet Flowers. I'll mark it out on your map...

talks.objective: Give the bait materials to Kayvan

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: The bait this time requires Sunsettia, Wheat, and Padisarah. Did you get them all?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: The bait this time requires Sunsettia, Wheat, and Fresh Harra Fruits. Did you get them all?

talks.objective: Give the bait materials to Kayvan

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: Please try the new bait again, Mr. Kayvan.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: I've done that so many times, but the results are just the same as before!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why are the two of you fishing together again?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Traveler, we meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: Hello, you two.

choices.text: Have you found out why the fish refuse to take the bait?

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: Haha! Nope. A researcher and I tried methods like modifying the fishing rod, adjusting the bait, and improving our techniques.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: We tried so many different bodies of water and angles... I even tried fishing in a pond full of fish.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: But no matter what I did, I could only fish up things that aren't fish.

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: Don't worry, Mr. Kayvan. Didn't that researcher promise to keep researching? He'll definitely determine the reason behind all this for us.

response.speaker: Helbet
response.text: See, he even designed a new bait for you, and he wants me to stay here with you and record every detail about your fishing process down...

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: I hope he really succeeds... But until then, I'll just continue fishing my way.

response.speaker: Kayvan
response.text: If you would, Traveler, could you get me some more material for bait?

choices.text: Did you learn anything from the researchers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of materials do you need this time?

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: Let me think... This time, I need Fresh Harra Fruits for my bait.

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: There's a place somewhere that has pretty good Harra Fruits. I'll mark it out on your map...

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: The bait this time requires Sunsettia, Wheat, and a Special Sweet Flower. Did you get them all?

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: Thank you, please give them to Mr. Kayvan...

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: I'm feeling pretty good today. It probably won't take long to catch something once I get the materials and make some bait.

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: I hope you'll be able to catch a fish today...

dialogues.speaker: Kayvan
dialogues.text: I'm feeling pretty good today. It probably won't take long to catch something once I get the materials and make some bait.

dialogues.speaker: Helbet
dialogues.text: I hope you'll be able to catch a fish today...
